status: DESCRIPTIVE — CAP-80 LARGER-28 SELECTION-RULE TRACE; NO TARGET, FREEZE, GRANT OR A1 CELL
question: Which K-selection and A-selection rules produce the cap-80 larger-28 A\K and K\A edge sets?
definition: For each larger-28 candidate edge at prediction cap 80, record whether it is A-only or K-only and the engine gate that kept it out of the other set. K reasons cover the 2/3-cycle strength floor and the MAX_LOOPS=15 rank cut; A reasons cover the PREDICTION_MIN_COUNT=5 floor, the half-budget transition quota and the cooccurrence quota.
method: One no-arm replay per seed. A behavior-neutral wrapper records the full prediction order and the full loop order before the engine applies its caps; the returned A/K sets still come from the unmodified service. Cap-80 A, K and A∩K must reproduce the committed overlap artifact exactly.
reading: The 104 A\K edges are dominated by `loop_rank_above_loop_cap` (104/104); the 338 K\A edges are dominated by `transition_rank_below_half_budget` (254/338). The overlap loss is therefore a K-side loop-rank effect plus an A-side budget/rank effect, with the support floor a minority component.
not_evidence: A descriptive rule trace on six no-arm larger-28 seeds at one cap pair. It attributes excluded edges to the engine gate they hit; it does not establish that changing that gate would repair the overlap, and it is not a treatment, target viability or a successor.
